aiStatement: In Product Code Data Segment (Data Segment No. 102), field 8 (Unit Price) is required and must be present.

independentTestRule.title: Unit Price preserves the assumed-decimal-place leading digit
independentTestRule.scopeDifference: This rule addresses decimal-format semantics; it is not a dedicated field-presence rule.

facts: Segment 102 Product Code Data field 8 is Element 107 Unit Price, length 9, marked Required (R).
The source also describes Unit Price assumed-decimal encoding; its 0.059/three-place example is used only for a populated design vector.

aiCaseReview.assessment: Four candidate payloads declare Element 107 omitted; four record exact Unit Price 000. All share the same bounded product-context metadata. These are producer observations only; value 000 has not been authorized as a valid Unit Price oracle for the represented operation.

requiredEvidenceForAdjudication: Authorized Test-owner confirmation of valid Unit Price values for the product/unit context and when the product record applies.
Complete Segment 102 request fixtures with source-validated Unit Price presence and omitted-field mutation.
